decisions.reason: False scope rejection: def-qft-qed-gauge-data is a mathematics-domain definition of smooth maps, fixed Clifford matrices and symbolic unit conventions; its Definition expressly adopts no measured charge or continuum-existence premise. F3 supplies only the separate phase convention. Finite coefficient cancellation gives KS=SK=I, conjugation gives covariance, differentiating KS=I gives delta S=-S(delta K)S, and the commutator and resolvent identities follow by multiplication. No physical premise is used.

The cited coherent-ir-obstruction carrier explicitly gives P_T(n)=I-n n^top in Facts F1 and Proof 1.1; the Construction references that exact supplier, so the profile is defined by earlier mathematical data. Thus b(n)=e-n(n dot e) is continuous, bounded, and n dot b=0. The rotated sphere patch has area at least 1/4 and |b| squared at least 3/4, giving C_b>=3/16>0. The supplier proves unit coherent vectors in D(H_ph), uniform energy <=hbar c C_b kappa and weak limit zero with no strong limit. The alleged undefined-map gap is absent.

False domain rejection: coherent-ir-obstruction is a mathematics-domain lemma about a specified transverse L2 space, a maximal multiplier and symmetric Fock direct sum, with symbolic positive hbar,c and Countable Choice. It assumes no physical postulate or observation. The local projection identity gives |b| squared=lambda squared(1-(n dot e) squared); the sphere chart has Gram density one and null seam/poles, so 2pi lambda squared integral_{-1}^{1}(1-u squared)du=8pi lambda squared/3. This is an admissible purely mathematical dependency and calculation.

Confirmed logical gap in the polarization clause: the tree supplier proves ell_a J^a=0 only for the current's own transfer ell, while the old statement shifts every such current along the unrelated fixed k. For mu=1 choose p1=p2'= (sqrt(2),1,0,0) and p1'=p2=(1,0,0,0), hence k=(sqrt(2)-1,1,0,0). A separate rest scattering current with p=p'=(1,0,0,0), u=(1,0,0,0)^T has ell=0 and J=(1,0,0,0), so k_a J^a=sqrt(2)-1 is nonzero. The repaired clause explicitly requires k=ell or -ell for each of the two supplied current forms; the kernel clause is retained. Lowering with h makes the cancellation exact.
